description: Email several pages to the same people in one invitation email. Each recipient gets one email listing every page, with their own personal link to each; who opened each page shows on that page. Use send_page for a single page. Sends email immediately; sent email cannot be recalled.

bundleName.description: Title of the email and of this set of pages, e.g. "Q4 proposal pack" (up to 120 characters). Defaults to the page names.

expiresInDays.description: Days the links work (default 7). 0 means they never expire.

message.description: Optional note shown above the list of pages.

pages.description: Published pages to send, in the order the email lists them (1 to 10). Each is {siteId, note}; plain page id strings also work.

note.description: Optional note shown under this page, up to 500 characters.

siteId.description: Page id (siteId) returned by a publish tool or list_pages.

recipients.description: Email addresses; each person gets their own personal link to every page.

name: send_pages

expiresAt.description: When the links stop working (ms since epoch; year 9999 means never).

shares.description: One send per page, in the order sent, each with shareId and siteId.

title: Send pages
